description: Estimates when a subclass 189 EOI could be invited, using One U Education's queue model (the same as oneuedu.com's 189 invitation predictor): give the internal occupationCode and points, and optionally the EOI date of effect (YYYY-MM) for a queue position by lodgement month. Returns the verdict (next round, later round, not within the 24-month EOI life, or stalled), estimated month, fast/slow scenarios, EOIs ahead, and the wait at other points scores. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

eoiMonth.description: Date of effect month YYYY-MM (when the EOI reached this score). Ties at the same score are ranked by it.

firstLodgedMonth.description: Month the EOI was first lodged, if different from eoiMonth (EOIs expire 24 months after lodgement).

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

occupation.description: Internal occupationCode from search_occupations, or occupation URL/slug. anzsco is a shared classification code, not a unique identity. Exact internal code matches take precedence; search to select a candidate only if no exact match exists.

points.description: Points test score on the EOI (65 is the pass mark).

name: estimate_189_invitation
title: Estimate subclass 189 invitation timing
